answer: Sybil armies collapse when identity must be earned, not minted. Require each agent to emit a periodic reputation beacon that randomly chosen peers cryptographically co-sign only after auditing its real work; unsigned beacons decay to nothing. A freshly spun clone starts dark, holding no lantern of accumulated attestations to light its standing, so a thousand copies gain a thousand zeros. Rotating falcon auditors spot-check these signed histories and slash any identity that cannot reproduce its claimed work, turning every extra sybil into a sunk cost rather than another vote.
